# Type System, Scalars and `Unit`

Edva is statically typed with zero runtime type information (RTTI). All types are checked and unified at compile time and lowered directly to machine registers or arena-backed layouts.

## Complete type taxonomy and ABI layout

| Category | Edva Syntax | Size & Alignment (64-bit) | LLVM Lowering | Reference Chapter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Signed integers** | `Int` (`i64`), `i8`, `i16`, `i32` | 8B, 1B, 2B, 4B | `i64`, `i8`, `i16`, `i32` | [Below](#integer-scalars-int-i8..i64-u8..u64) |
| **Unsigned integers** | `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `u64` | 1B, 2B, 4B, 8B | `i8`, `i16`, `i32`, `i64` | [Below](#integer-scalars-int-i8..i64-u8..u64) |
| **Floating-point** | `Float` (`f64`), `f32` | 8B (align 8), 4B (align 4) | `double`, `float` | [Below](#floating-point-scalars-float-f32) |
| **Unicode scalar** | `Rune` | 4B (align 4) | `i32` | [Below](#unicode-characters-rune) |
| **Zero-sized unit** | `()` (`Unit`) | 0B | `void` | [Below](#zero-sized-unit-type) |
| **Byte string** | `String` | 16B (align 8) | `{ i64 len, ptr data }` | [`String` & `Builder`](string.qmd) |
| **Byte buffer** | `Builder` (`{cap}`) | 24B (align 8) | `{ i64 len, ptr data, i64 cap }` | [`String` & `Builder`](string.qmd) |
| **Flag (`RamNN`)** | `<>` | 1 bit / 1B | `i1` | [Flags, Ramifications & `Error`](ram.qmd) |
| **Option / Fallible** | `< T | >`, `< | E >` | 8B (`ptr` niche) or `{ i1, T }` | `ptr` / `{ i1, T }` | [Flags, Ramifications & `Error`](ram.qmd) |
| **Result (`RamPP`)** | `< T | E >` | 16B unboxed register pair | `{ i1, i64 }` | [Flags, Ramifications & `Error`](ram.qmd) |
| **Structured error** | `Error` | Pointer to 6-field struct | `ptr` | [Flags, Ramifications & `Error`](ram.qmd) |
| **Record / Tuple** | `(a: T1, b: T2)`, `(T * N)` | C ABI / `#packed` / `#align N` | `{ T1, T2, ... }` | [Records, Tuples, Bitfields & Enums](record.qmd) |
| **Nominal enum** | `< V1, V2(T) >` | 16B (align 8) | `{ i64 tag, ptr payload }` | [Records, Tuples, Bitfields & Enums](record.qmd) |
| **Growable array** | `T{}` / `T{cap}` | 24B (align 8) | `{ i64 len, ptr data, i64 cap }` | [Arrays, Slices & Maps](array.qmd) |
| **Slice view** | `T[]` | 16B (align 8) | `{ i64 len, ptr data }` | [Arrays, Slices & Maps](array.qmd) |
| **Hash map** | `K ^ V` | 8B handle (`ptr`) | `ptr` (arena hash table) | [Arrays, Slices & Maps](array.qmd) |
| **Function / closure** | `A, B => R` | 16B (align 8) | `{ ptr fn_ptr, ptr env_ptr }` | [Functions & Closures](functions.qmd) |
| **Compile-time type** | `Type` (`#!`) | 0B (erased before codegen) | *Erased* | [Compile-Time (`#!`) & `Type` Reflection](type.qmd) |
| **Raw pointer** | `Addr` (`ptr`) | 8B on 64-bit, 4B on 32-bit | `ptr` | [Memory, Arenas, `Addr` & FFI](addr.qmd) |

## Integer scalars (`Int`, `i8`..`i64`, `u8`..`u64`)

`Int` is **strictly 64-bit signed (`i64`) on all target architectures** (including 32-bit `wasm32`). Fixed-width integers provide exact C-ABI and hardware register widths.

| Type | Bits | Signed | Minimum Value | Maximum Value | Literal Suffix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `i8` | 8 | Yes | $-128$ | $127$ | `127i8` |
| `u8` | 8 | No | $0$ | $255$ | `255u8` |
| `i16` | 16 | Yes | $-32,768$ | $32,767$ | `1000i16` |
| `u16` | 16 | No | $0$ | $65,535$ | `8080u16` |
| `i32` | 32 | Yes | $-2,147,483,648$ | $2,147,483,647$ | `42i32` |
| `u32` | 32 | No | $0$ | $4,294,967,295$ | `0x80000000u32` |
| `Int` / `i64` | 64 | Yes | $-9,223,372,036,854,775,808$ | $9,223,372,036,854,775,807$ | `42` or `42i64` |
| `u64` | 64 | No | $0$ | $18,446,744,073,709,551,615$ | `42u64` |

### Integer operations and conversions

| Operation | Syntax | Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| Arithmetic | `+` `-` `*` `/` `%` | Same-width integer arithmetic (`/` truncates toward zero; mixing `Int` with `Float` promotes to `Float`) |
| Bitwise | `.&.` `.|.` `.^.` `.!.` | Bitwise AND, OR, XOR, and unary one's-complement NOT (`.!.x`) |
| Shifts | `.<.` `.>.` | Left shift and right shift |
| Comparisons | `==` `!=` `<` `>` `!<` `!>` | Returns `<>` (`!<` is $\ge$, `!>` is $\le$) |
| Explicit width cast | `i16(x)`, `u8(x)`, `Int(x)` | Explicit truncation, zero-extension, or sign-extension (no implicit integer widening) |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

mask = 0b1{8}
port = 8080u16
io::out $ (mask .&. 0xFF, Int(port), 20 / 6, 20 % 6)
```

## Floating-point scalars (`Float`, `f32`)

| Type | Bits | Significand Bits | Decimal Precision | Exponent Range | Literal Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `f32` | 32 | 24 | ~7 digits | $10^{-38} \dots 10^{38}$ | `1.25f32` |
| `Float` / `f64` | 64 | 53 | ~15–17 digits | $10^{-308} \dots 10^{308}$ | `3.141592653589793`, `1.0e-9` |

### Floating-point semantics and NaN ordering

| Rule | Expression | Result when Operand is `NaN` | Explanation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ordered relational | `a < b`, `a > b`, `a !< b`, `a !> b` | `<->` (false) | LLVM `OLT` / `OGT` / `OGE` / `OLE` |
| Logical negation | `!(a < b)` | `<+>` (true) | Negates the `<->` result of `a < b` (distinct from `a !< b`) |
| Equality / inequality | `a == b` / `a != b` | `<->` / `<+>` | LLVM `OEQ` / `UNE` (`nan != nan` is `<+>`) |
| Explicit conversion | `Float(n)`, `Int(f)`, `f32(f)` | — | `Int(f)` truncates toward zero |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

nan = 0.0 / 0.0
io::out $ (nan !< 1.0, !(nan < 1.0), Int(3.99), Float(42))
```

## Unicode characters (`Rune`)

`Rune` represents a 32-bit Unicode scalar value (`U+0000`..`U+D7FF`, `U+E000`..`U+10FFFF`), lowered as `i32` (`#size Rune == 4`).

| Operation | Syntax | Result Type | Behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rune literal | `'a'`, `'λ'`, `'🦀'`, `'\n'`, `'\x1b'`, `'\u{1F600}'` | `Rune` | Single Unicode codepoint |
| Offset arithmetic | `'a' + 1`, `ch - 'a'` | `Rune` / `Int` | Direct codepoint arithmetic with `Int` |
| Comparison | `ch !< 'a' && ch !> 'z'` | `<>` | Codepoint order comparison |
| Builder UTF-8 append | `b += '🦀'` | `()` | Encodes 1–4 UTF-8 bytes directly into `Builder` `b` |
| Explicit cast | `Rune(0x1F680)`, `Int('λ')` | `Rune` / `Int` | Zero-cost identity conversion |
| String length vs runes | `?str` vs `??str` | `Int` | `?str` returns UTF-8 byte count; `??str` counts Unicode runes |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

b = {16}
b += 'A
b += 'λ
b += '🦀
s = +b
io::out $ (?s, ??s, Int('λ))   // (7, 3, 955)
```

## Zero-sized `Unit` type (`()`)

`()` represents the zero-sized type (lowered to LLVM `void`).

| Context | Syntax | Validity & Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Type signature** | `log: String => ()`<br>`cb: (Int => ()) => ()` | **Valid**: declares void return or void callback parameter | — |
| **Type-shape guard (`#!`)** | `T [()] "unit" | "other"` | **Valid**: matches `Unit` at compile time | — |
| **Value expression** | `x = ()` or `f(())` | **Forbidden**: `()` is strictly a type, never a value literal | `E2104` |
| **Implicit unit producers** | `x = 10`, `cond | side_effect()`, `--| expr`, empty ram slots | Evaluate to `()` at the expression site with 0 runtime bytes | — |
